description:
Chainlink is the free nightlife app for going out with your friends. Let your drinking buddies know you're out, find tonight's events and drink deals at bars near you, and compete on every bar's nightly leaderboard for badges and real rewards.

LET YOUR FRIENDS KNOW YOU'RE OUT

One tap tells your friends you're down to go out tonight. They get notified, see which bar you're headed to, and can join your party. No group text, no "where is everyone?"

GO OUT TOGETHER

Build your party, see who's on the way and who has arrived, and check in automatically when you get to the bar. Barhopping? Your next stop is one tap away.

TRACK YOUR DRINKS

Log every round by scanning the bar's QR code or snapping a photo of your drink. Your tab keeps a running record of the night.

Share photos and videos on a bar's wall while you're there. Your Wall shows posts and drinks from your friends and your favorite bars.

EARN BADGES AT YOUR FAVORITE BARS

Progress badges grow with every visit. Check in for the first time, become a regular with 3, 5, 10 or 100 visits, post to the wall, track your drinks and bring a bigger group. Every bar keeps its own trophy case.

TRADE BADGES FOR REWARDS

Participating bars post bounties: trade the badges you've earned for free drinks, merch and other rewards.

WHY CHAINLINK

- Know when your friends are going out, and where

- Find bar deals and things to do tonight near you

- Track drinks and nights out with your crew

- Compete with friends and regulars at your local bar

- Earn real rewards for going out

- 100% free - no subscriptions, no in-app purchases

FOR BAR AND CLUB OWNERS

Claim your venue free at thechainlinkapp.com to post events and deals, see who's coming, run rewards and bring in new guests.

Learn more: https://www.thechainlinkapp.com/features/mobile-app

Please drink responsibly, and never drink and drive.

description:
Munkki is a private place for your memories. Just for you. Or for the few people who really matter to you.

Capture your moments. Use photos, videos, voice messages, text or files. You can also save where you were, what the weather was like and which song you were listening to. You don’t need anyone else for this. Munkki can simply be your personal memory box.

You can also share your memories. Share them with your partner, your family or your best friends. That’s what a huddle is for. A huddle holds up to 7 people. Real closeness only works in a small circle. Your huddle reacts to your memories with comments, GIFs and stickers.

Sometimes a small sign is enough. That’s what munkkis are for. A munkki is a short message to someone in your huddle. For example “Thinking of you” or “Good morning”.

On Munkki there are no followers, no likes and no strangers. There is no public feed either. Everything is end-to-end encrypted.

Munkki is free. There are no ads, no tracking and no algorithm. The people who use the app pay for it. If you need more storage, you can buy it. You can also support Munkki just because you want to. But you don’t have to. Your memories belong to you. You can export them and take them with you at any time.

description:
REDnote helps when you want everyday inspiration that feels real and useful. The app focuses on fashion, beauty, travel, food, home decor, music, and pets, so you can browse practical ideas and experiences from people around the world. Content is organized as short videos and photos with captions that read like notes. As you explore, you see friendly discussions, tips, and reviews rather than just entertainment. This mix suits users who prefer community guidance and daily ideas, and it makes trying the REDnote APK a straightforward choice.


Key features in REDnote

Personalized discovery feed

REDnote tailors a discovery feed around your interests. As you view and interact with notes, the feed adjusts to show more of what you like across lifestyle topics. This helps you surface practical ideas faster, from outfits and skincare routines to quick recipes and travel suggestions.

Create and browse visual notes

You can post short form videos and photos with concise captions that act like a note to others. At the same time, it is easy to follow creators, like posts, add comments, and save favorites. This format keeps posts focused and scannable, so browsing and contributing both feel simple.

Product reviews and shopping tips

REDnote places verified opinions and everyday reviews at the center of its shopping content. Users share why a product worked for them, how they use it, and what to expect in real life. This helps you evaluate fashion, beauty, home, and gadget buys with grounded feedback before making a decision.

Travel guides, recipes, and life hacks

Beyond products, the community publishes itineraries, packing lists, hometown food spots, and practical cooking guides. You also find small daily hacks for organizing, studying, and wellness. These notes are brief and specific, which makes them easy to try the same day.

Authentic and inclusive community

Across the app, REDnote encourages original posts, clear credits, and respectful conversation. Users are guided to share real experiences and useful tips, not staged trends. This approach supports a welcoming space where feedback focuses on helping others.


About REDnote and Xiaohongshu

REDnote is widely known in China as Xiaohongshu. The name and branding can appear differently by region, yet the core idea remains the same. It is a lifestyle community built around visual notes, practical reviews, and friendly interactions. New users who prefer English can start by following creators who post in their language and using topic tags in English to refine the feed.


How REDnote differs from short video platforms

REDnote emphasizes lifestyle discovery and peer reviews more than viral challenges or pure entertainment. Posts usually include context, such as why a product is helpful or how to follow a routine step by step. This gives the app a blend of community guidance and visual inspiration that feels closer to a mix of Instagram and Pinterest with review-driven conversations. If you are comparing with TikTok, expect more how to notes and shopping insights rather than trend-first videos.


Regional availability and REDnote APK

Availability can vary by country and may change over time. In some regions, including parts of India, the app might not appear in local catalogs. If that happens, installing the REDnote APK on your Android device is a common route. Before you proceed, check that the app name and publisher match your expectations and review recent user feedback for your region.


Language tips for new users

Because REDnote began with a Chinese-first audience, you may see a mix of languages at the start. To adapt quickly, search topics using your preferred language, follow creators who write in that language, and save notes that match your interests. Also check the app settings to see if a language option is available in your build.


How to use REDnote on Android

Getting started takes only a few steps. After you download REDnote and install it on your phone, you can set up your profile and tailor the feed to your interests. The process below helps you begin without missing the basics.

  1. Open the app, then create an account or sign in. Add a profile photo and a short bio if you want others to recognize your posts.
  2. Next, choose a few interests such as fashion, beauty, travel, or food. This step helps the discovery feed show relevant notes sooner.
  3. Start browsing the feed. Follow creators you like, tap like on helpful posts, add comments, and save notes you want to revisit later.
  4. When ready to post, tap to create a new note. Select photos or a short video, write a clear caption, add tags, and publish.
  5. Finally, visit your profile to organize saved collections and review your posts. If available in your app version, adjust language or notification settings.


Start exploring with REDnote

REDnote focuses on practical lifestyle ideas, honest reviews, and inclusive community conversations. If you want everyday tips and visual guidance from real people, the REDnote latest version keeps that experience current across popular topics.

description:
Jagat helps users who want to stay aware of where family, friends, or partners are during daily life. Instead of only showing a pin on a map, the app brings location, messages, reminders, and shared moments into one place. As a result, it can support quick check ins, meetups, and closer contact when people are apart. Users looking for the Jagat app can use it as a social map for both safety and everyday connection.


Key Jagat Features

Live location map

Jagat shows where approved friends, family members, or partners are on a shared map. You can also see useful context such as where someone has been, how fast they are moving, battery level, who they are with, and what they are doing. This makes the map useful for daily coordination, especially when people are traveling, meeting up, or checking whether someone arrived safely.

Safety tools for close contacts

Jagat includes location reminders, a 30 day activity history, and One Tap SOS for moments when a fast response matters. You can use these tools to check on a loved one, notice changes in movement, or ask for help with fewer steps. In everyday use, these functions are most helpful when family members commute, friends go out, or partners want extra reassurance.

Tools for couples and long distance partners

Jagat also supports relationship focused use cases through anniversary reminders, couple widgets, chat backgrounds, and Miss You taps. You can keep small signs of connection visible even when schedules or distance make regular meetings difficult. These tools do not replace conversation, but they give partners a simple way to stay present in each other’s day.

Personal map memories

Jagat lets you record footprints, favorite places, memorable encounters, Highlights, NOW moments, and visited cities or countries. Over time, your map can become a record of where you have been and what places matter to you. This is useful for users who want more than location sharing and prefer to keep memories tied to real places.

Chat and social expression

Jagat includes chat, video sharing, emoji bombs, mood updates, and several customization options. You can adjust nicknames, bubbles, animations, and app icons to make conversations feel more personal. After checking the map, these social tools make it easier to continue the interaction in the same app.


Jagat Privacy Controls

Jagat includes privacy settings for users who want control over visibility. You can use Ghost Mode, Hide Yourself, status permissions, and blocking to decide who can see your location and activity. These controls matter because live location sharing works best when each user can choose what to share and when to limit access.

Before you download Jagat, it is useful to think about who you want to connect with and what kind of location access feels comfortable. For example, a family group may use location reminders often, while a friend group may focus more on meetups and NOW updates. Couples may prefer widgets and shared moments, while others may only want safety check ins.


Using Jagat on Android

After installing the Jagat APK, you can start by setting up your profile and choosing who to connect with. The app works best when trusted contacts also use Jagat and agree to share relevant location or activity details.

  1. Open Jagat on your Android phone, create or sign in to your account, then complete the basic profile details shown in the app.
  2. Add family members, friends, or a partner, and wait for them to accept before location and activity details appear on your shared map.
  3. Check the map to see approved contacts, then use movement details, battery level, and recent activity to understand the current situation.
  4. Set location reminders or use One Tap SOS when you need a safety check, quick help, or a clearer update from someone close.
  5. Use chat, mood updates, NOW moments, footprints, and favorite places to keep daily contact and save meaningful map memories.


Get Started with Jagat

Jagat combines live location sharing, safety support, messaging, couple tools, and personal map memories in one social map app. If these functions match how you stay connected with trusted people, you can download Jagat and set up your close contacts from your Android phone.

Official information for Jagat is available through the following channels:

description:
Meet penpals worldwide, write real letters and make global friends. SnailPost is a slow pen pal app that works slowly where every letter travels slowly, just like real snail mail.

Find a pen pal, exchange thoughtful letters, practise a language and discover new cultures, one letter at a time. No instant chat. No pressure to reply in seconds. Just honest, handwritten-style conversations with people in countries all over the world.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE SNAILPOST

- LETTERS THAT TRAVEL SLOWLY

Every letter takes real time to arrive, based on the distance between you and your pen pal. A letter from a nearby country can land in hours. A letter crossing the world takes a few days. Snail mail, reimagined for your phone: slower letters, deeper conversations.

- FIND PEN PALS WHO ACTUALLY MATCH YOU

Search penpals by country, language, age and interests. Find someone who loves books, music, films, travel, nature or writing. Whether you want one close pen pal or friends across many countries, SnailPost helps you find people worth writing to.

- LANGUAGE EXCHANGE, ONE LETTER AT A TIME

SnailPost is a natural language exchange app. Write to a language partner, practise the language you are learning and read letters from native speakers. Letter writing gives you time to think, look words up and write carefully, which makes it far better for learning a language than rushed chatting.

- WRITE WITHOUT PRESSURE

No typing indicators. No guilt for replying late. Take a day or take a week and send letters when you genuinely have something to say. Slow letters make room for real thoughts.

- COLLECT AND SEND SPECIAL STAMPS

Add a personal touch to every letter with collectible stamps. Send a letter faster, get a confirmation when it is opened, schedule a letter for a birthday or special occasion, or attach photos from your week.

- TRACK YOUR GLOBAL JOURNEY

See every country you have written to and the total distance your letters have travelled. Share your SnailPost passport and show the world where your letters have been.

- A SAFER SPACE FOR REAL CONVERSATIONS

Profile verification, reporting, blocking and privacy controls keep conversations respectful. Your exact location is never shown. Only your country and an approximate distance are used to deliver letters.

- FREE TO START

Find penpals, write letters and build friendships for free. Optional premium features and special stamps are available for people who want more.

WHO IS SNAILPOST FOR

- Anyone who wants to make friends from different countries

- Language learners looking for a language exchange partner abroad

- People who want meaningful conversations instead of instant chatting

- Introverts and thoughtful writers who express themselves better in letters

- Travellers, readers and culture lovers curious about everyday life elsewhere

- Anyone who misses the excitement of waiting for real mail

QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK

Is SnailPost a free pen pal app?

Yes. Finding penpals and writing letters is free. Premium stamps are optional.

Do I need a postal address to use SnailPost?

No. SnailPost sends digital letters. Your address is never required or shown.

Can I use SnailPost for language exchange?

Yes. Many members are language learners looking for a pen pal to practise a language with, so you can write in the language you are learning and get replies from native speakers.

How long does a letter take to arrive?

It depends on the distance between you and your pen pal. Letters from nearby countries can arrive within hours, while letters travelling across the world take a few days.

Is SnailPost like other chat or friend apps?

No. There is no instant messaging here. SnailPost is built for slow letters, real friendships and conversations that are worth waiting for.

Slow letters. Real friendships. A world of penpals waiting to hear from you. Download SnailPost and write your first letter today.

description:
Crossed is a social memory map. Two people pair by QR code or a short code, and only after BOTH agree, the app reveals where their PAST paths may have approximately crossed — the cities you both passed through, the places you may have shared, and the Closest Moment your lives came near, all before you ever met.

Crossed is built on one idea: you may have crossed paths before you ever met. It is private by default, powered by mutual consent, and it never reveals anything one-sided.

Crossed is NOT a dating app, NOT a people-finder, and NOT a location tool. There is no "people near you," no live location, and no following anyone. Nothing is ever revealed unless both people opt in.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pair — Connect with someone you already know by scanning a QR code, opening an invite link, or typing a short code.

2. Consent — Both people agree to compare. No one-sided Reveal: if either person declines, nothing is shown.

3. Reveal — Crossed builds your shared Cross Map: how many times your Life Paths overlapped, your Past Overlap score, and the story of where your histories came closest.

WHAT YOU DISCOVER

- Cross Map — an approximate map of where your Life Paths overlapped in the past.

- Closest Moment — the point in time your two paths likely came nearest.

- Shared Places — cities and areas you both probably passed through, ranked by confidence.

- Past Overlap — a simple score and summary of how much your histories intersect.

- Reports & Life Map — a Monthly and Yearly Life Map that turns your Crosses into a personal recap.

- Deep Cross Report — an optional in-depth read of a single Cross.

- Saved — keep the Crosses that matter and build your own social memory archive over time.

- Crossed Circle — a closed, invite-only group Cross for three or more friends, with the same consent-first rules.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE

- Mutual consent always. No Cross is ever revealed one-sided.

- Approximate-first. Crossed works with rough areas and time ranges — never precise tracking, and never a claim that you were "exactly" in one place.

- Foreground location only. When-in-use location and on-device photo date and place metadata help build your memory map, only with your permission. Background location is not required and is not used.

- Private by default. You choose what to share, and you can delete your data or your whole account from Settings at any time.

WHY PEOPLE USE CROSSED

Every new person you meet is a quiet question: did our paths ever cross before today? Crossed turns that curiosity into a shared, consent-based discovery — and, over time, a growing map of the coincidences behind the people in your life.

Crossed is free to use. Deeper features like the Deep Cross Report and the Yearly Life Map may be offered as optional upgrades.

You may have crossed paths before you ever met. Now you can find out — together.
whats_new:
Large location exports now import.

If your Google Timeline export was refused as "too big", it will work now — Crossed reads a big file in pieces instead of loading all of it at once.

Also fixed: the file picker no longer hides your export, invite codes no longer stop working after 48 hours, and an empty result now tells you whether there was nothing to compare or nothing in common.

description:
TikTok Lite suits Android users who need a TikTok option for limited storage, smaller data plans, or unreliable connections. It keeps the familiar short video format while placing less demand on a phone and mobile data. As a result, it can be useful on older or entry level devices that may struggle with larger apps. Users who want to download TikTok Lite can use it to follow creators, explore topics, and stay connected through short video posts.


Core features

Lower data and storage use

TikTok Lite is designed to take up less device storage and use less data while streaming short videos. The Data Saver setting can reduce streaming data usage by up to 20%. In addition, cached videos may remain available when your connection becomes slow or unstable.

For You feed and search

You can browse a personalized For You feed that changes based on the videos and creators you interact with. TikTok Lite also lets you search for topics, hashtags, music, and creators. You can save videos to Favorites, follow accounts, and keep track of local or global trends.

Viewing controls

TikTok Lite includes Auto Scroll for watching videos without repeatedly swiping the screen. Clean View can enlarge the video and hide interface elements for a less crowded screen. These controls can be useful when you want to focus on a video instead of comments or buttons.

Video and photo posts

You can record videos of up to three minutes or upload video clips of up to 15 minutes. Before posting, TikTok Lite lets you add music, filters, effects, voiceovers, and green screen backgrounds. You can also make Duets with eligible videos or create image based posts through Photo Mode.

Comments, messages, and sharing

You can like videos, write comments, follow creators, and adjust who can interact with your posts. TikTok Lite supports messaging between users on TikTok Lite and TikTok. When a video is ready to share, you can send it to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, or Snapchat.


Availability and limits

Before installing a TikTok Lite APK, it is useful to know that some functions can vary by country and app version. Certain stickers, effects, gestures, shopping interactions, and comment tools may not appear for every account. TikTok Lite Rewards is no longer available in the EU, and other regional programs may also differ by location.


TikTok Lite loading and feature issues

Slow loading of videos, profile images, or Favorite thumbnails can happen when a network connection changes or cached content is incomplete. A blank or frozen video with audio, comments that remain from the previous video, or an “all features ready soon” message can also affect some users. If a feature such as collections is unavailable, it may be limited in the current version or region rather than disabled by a phone setting.

To report a problem in TikTok Lite, open Profile, select Menu, then choose Settings and privacy and Report a problem. Include the affected feature and what happened, such as videos failing to load or comments not changing after scrolling. This gives the support team details that can help identify the issue.


How to use TikTok Lite on Android

After installing the TikTok Lite latest version, sign in or create an account to save preferences and interact with other users. You can start by watching the feed, then adjust settings based on your data connection and viewing habits.

  1. Open the app and scroll through the For You feed to watch short videos. Use search when you want to find a creator, topic, hashtag, or music track.

description:
SwingTrack turns your tennis videos into match analysis. Film a rally or a practice session on your phone, upload the clip and let SwingTrack's cloud analysis do the rest: no extra hardware or sensors needed.

WHAT YOU GET FROM EVERY CLIP

- Ball tracking: the ball is detected frame by frame and drawn as a trail on your video.

- Bounces: every bounce is marked, so you can see exactly where your shots land.

- Shots and rallies: SwingTrack counts shots and rallies for a quick summary of each clip.

- Heatmaps: bounce and player-position heatmaps on a bird's-eye court show patterns you can't see in real time.

- Processed video: watch the analysed video with overlays right in the app, or share it.

REELS

Cut a highlight reel from your analysed clips and share your best points with friends, your coach or your team.

CLOUD ANALYSIS

The heavy processing runs on cloud GPUs, not on your phone, so analysis is fast and your battery is spared. You can follow progress in the app and get an email when your analysis is ready. Your library keeps your matches and reels in one place, and the same account works on the SwingTrack website.

CREDITS

- Analysing a clip or making a reel costs 1 credit.

- You get 3 free credits every day.

- Need more? Watch a short ad to earn an extra credit (daily limit applies).

PREMIUM

Go Premium for an ad-free experience with monthly credits included. Subscriptions are billed through Google Play and can be cancelled at any time in your Play account settings.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Record a rally or match. A stable, elevated camera behind the baseline works best.

2. Choose the video and the part you want to analyse.

3. SwingTrack processes the clip in the cloud.

4. Watch the result with ball trail, bounces, stats and heatmaps, then make a reel.

SwingTrack is built for players, coaches and parents who want more from the videos they already record. Track every shot.

This innovative app allows users to register and collaborate efficiently to accomplish a wide range of essential tasks, fostering a spirit of community service and social responsibility.

With Seva Setu, both receivers and donors can easily register on the app, providing their details to create a robust network of support. Receivers can add service work, detailing the name, description, start date, and end date of the service work.

Donors can see service work approved or posted from the backend. They can choose service work based on what they can handle. Once a service work is picked, it can be withdrawn or updated anytime by adding a description and uploading related images.

The primary goal of the Seva Setu App is to streamline and enhance the process of completing government-related tasks,making it easier for citizens to communicate their needs directly to the Government (admin). By facilitating this direct connection, the app ensures that work are completed in a timely and efficient manner, promoting transparency and fostering positive social change.

Seva Setu not only simplifies the administrative process but also empowers individuals to contribute meaningfully to their communities, ensuring that government assistance reaches those who need it most.

This is a unique initiative of Indore city district administration in association with CitizenCOP Foundation.

All writers have their favorite words. Some of yours might be CASH-WINNING CONTEST!

We creators love to create.

But let’s be real.

Creators need cash to create.

And even buy food sometimes.

This app isn’t only about connection. It’s about putting in the work and having the chance to be recognized.

So…calling all creative writers!

Enter our short story contest.

Write it.

Submit it.

Get your chance to win some cash!

Like our style? Read on, new creative friend.

Finding a good creative partnership is like finding the perfect dating match. The chemistry is a must, but you also want someone who understands your project goals, needs, and timeline. Because it’s never easy to find “the one” to work with, we brought Creativist to life.

Creativist is designed to help you choose the right person to take your masterpiece to the next level. Our app features profiles and portfolios of likeminded creators who share similar intentions—making a living by living out their creative passions.

As a community of freelance artists, writers, editors, photographers, and designers, Creativist connects kindred spirits in creativity—like you! Whether you’re self-publishing or submitting to a major publisher, find the talent you need to elevate your work.

This could look like:

• A freelance writer teaming up with an illustrator to create a children’s book

• An artist and an author turning a great idea into a great graphic novel

• A blogger pairing with a designer to make their website look amazing

• A photographer looking for the perfect social media wordsmith

• An editor making magic out of a writer’s manuscript

Start by reviewing each other’s past work to decide if it’s the right fit. Like what you see? Reach out and say hello to begin a collaboration. Once it’s a match, the two of you take it from there. Deadlines, pay structure, and deliverables are all handled and agreed upon by both parties and happen outside of the Creativist platform.

Creativist is free to download and use. But we also have premium features! To get the best of Creativist, sign up for our subscription plan at $9.99 per month.

Subscriptions unlock Creativist’s functionality as per plan and can be cancelled within a set period of time identified within our terms and conditions. Payment is charged to the credit card that is connected to your iTunes account. Auto-renewals must be turned off within 24 hours of the current subscription period to avoid being charged for the next subscription period. The management of you subscription can be done within the app. Once a subscription is initiated, any unused portions of your free trial are forfeited.

description:
# SlowInk is a letter-writing and pen pal app where meaningful friendships begin with thoughtful letters.

In a world of instant messages, endless scrolling and constant notifications, SlowInk offers a slower, more thoughtful way to connect.

Write digital letters, discover pen pals, collect digital stamps and share stories with people from around the world. Build genuine friendships through meaningful conversations that unfold one letter at a time.

Like traditional mail, every letter has its own journey. SlowInk brings back the anticipation, warmth and sincerity of letter writing in a modern digital experience.

## FEATURES

### ✉️ Private Letters

Write thoughtful letters to friends and pen pals. Enjoy meaningful conversations that grow naturally, one letter at a time.

### 🌍 Global Pen Pals

Meet pen pals from different countries, cultures and backgrounds. Discover new perspectives, exchange stories and build meaningful friendships through thoughtful letters.

### 📬 Public Letters

Read and share public letters with people around the world. Explore personal stories, memories, reflections and experiences, or publish your own letters for others to discover.

### 🎟 Digital Stamps

Collect beautifully designed digital stamps and build your own collection with every letter you send and receive.

### ⏳ Time Capsules

Write messages to your future self or save today's special moments for tomorrow. Reopen your letters when the time is right and rediscover your memories.

### 💌 Thoughtful Messages

Stay connected through thoughtful messages and meaningful interactions that make every conversation feel more personal.

## WHY SLOWINK

SlowInk is built around the belief that genuine friendships and meaningful conversations cannot be rushed.

Instead of chasing instant replies and endless feeds, SlowInk encourages reflection, patience and authentic communication. Every letter takes time to arrive, creating anticipation, emotional connection and conversations that truly matter.

SlowInk isn't about replying faster. It's about writing better.

Whether you're looking for international pen pals, international friends, self-expression or simply a calmer social experience, SlowInk provides a welcoming space where every letter matters.

## PERFECT FOR

• Pen Pals

• Cultural Exchange

• Public Letters

## PRIVACY & SECURITY

• Your private letters are always visible only to you and your recipient

• We never use your data for third-party advertising

SlowInk is intended for users aged **16+**.

Questions or feedback?

https://api.slowink.cn/legal/privacy-policy-en.html

**Make sure you have an epic night:**

Have you met someone you vibed with? Find them on Plura, match with them, and deepen the connection. Our data shows that matching after an event happens 10X more than with traditional swiping.

At Plura, we're a welcoming community that encourages you to be yourself and connect with others. We hope that all the people you meet on the platform are continually working to become better at consent, more skilled in communication, and prioritize inclusion over fear.

**Consent**

At its best, consent is an ongoing collaboration between two or more people in constant verbal, physical, and emotional dialogue about what each other needs to willingly, safely, and pleasurably engage in an interaction with one another. Consent must be affirmative, competent, informed, unprepared, specific, and ongoing.

**Communication**

We express our interests, needs, and boundaries, which creates a shared space to connect and play. We choose discomfort over resentment and speak out when things don’t feel good. We equally invite people to communicate their experience whether it’s positive or negative.

**Inclusion**

To invite everyone to express themselves, organize, and connect, welcomed, and celebrated. Plura will not tolerate any sort of sexism, racism, transphobia, fatphobia, or ableism. Creating an inclusive and welcoming space requires work on all of our parts, especially those who have benefited from unequal power dynamics and move through the world with more privilege.

You can search any book you interest in, view it’s summery, reviews and ratings. You can create lists to save the books you want to keep in your account in them. You can join related group chat for each book, give the book rating and write your review on it.

User can navigate to other users profile - especially active users in challenges - from “Challenges” screen - View username Profile - or from “Profile” screen - in specific, from the list of users name that joined “Challenges I Created”.

In other users profile, a navigator can see the other user profile picture, bio, points, level, his/her public lists as “Books Lists” and “Challenges I Created” of this user and a navigator can join the other user challenges from it.

More about groups chat:

User Can search about active groups chat in the “Groups” screen in his/her acount.

* Users will get notifications when new challenge published.

* Users will get notification when new message arrived to a group that the user is a member in it or when new member joined the group .

description:
The entire PTT (Taiwanese online forum) is my chat room.

Every tweet can be instantly updated and replied to, just like in a chat room.

Watching live streams, trending articles, and sports games no longer requires constantly reloading. No ads.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Automatic Tweet Updates: The Entire PTT is My Chat Room】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

・Simply swipe up from the bottom of the article to automatically update the tweets, with new tweets popping up one after another.

・Chat Room Mode: Tweets are arranged like a conversation; you can easily see who tweeted what.

・Input boxes are directly at the bottom; you can go back to a tweet halfway through, and the input box automatically grows as the text increases.

・New tweets are marked; scrolling back to view older ones won't pull them away; returning to the bottom automatically catches up.

・Tweets that are too long are automatically split into several parts; URLs will never be split in half; excessively long URLs are automatically shortened.

・Those who don't want to swipe up can turn this off in the settings.

━━ ━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Smooth, gesture-based operation, easy to use with one hand】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

・Swipe right from anywhere on the screen to go back, no need to reach for the top left corner.

・Swipe left or right on the homepage to switch between My Favorites, Instant Hot Topics, Hot Board, Recently Viewed, and Followed Articles.

・Pull up from the bottom of the article to automatically update the post.

・The row of buttons at the bottom of the article (Post, Pin, Bottom, Share) is centrally located, accessible with both hands.

・Double-click on a post: Show only posts by that author, other posts will fade away.

・Long-press on a post or article: Search for author, view their articles, block, or give feedback. P-Coins

・Swipe left on the list: Report, Block

・Swipe left or right on images to view the next one, two fingers to zoom in

・Smooth scrolling through thousands of tweets and articles; image loading won't push you away from where you're halfway through.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Dual Columns on Tablets and Foldable Devices: List on the Left, Articles on the Right】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

・Tablets and foldable devices open to a dual column layout

・Drag the separator line to switch between "List Only/Separator/Article Only" at any time, or set it to a single column for all

・Articles and tweets on the right automatically update, while the left side still allows scrolling through the list and opening the next article

・Keyboard Connection: Up and down arrows to select articles, Enter to open, spacebar to turn pages

・When the window is tall enough, the search bar is placed directly above the list, and article titles are fixed at the top.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【One-Click Image Upload: isPTT】 [Your Own Image Hosting]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ You can directly upload photos when posting, replying, or tweeting, without having to go to other websites first.

• isPTT's own image hosting service (Cloudflare), short URLs, fit in a single tweet.

• Automatically compresses and removes personal information such as location from photos before uploading.

• Free storage for 6 months, VIP storage for 2 years; images with views automatically have their storage extended.

• You can choose the storage period when uploading.

• You can select multiple images at once for a post, upload them in sequence, and insert them into the text.

• You can tag NSFW; it will be blurred in isPTT before being displayed.

• You can also add other image hosting services you prefer, upload them from the app's webpage, and automatically paste the URL when you return.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Two-Step Verification, Multiple Accounts】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• PTT has enabled two-step verification (2FA) for direct login: built-in authenticator automatically provides a 6-digit verification code upon login, without switching to another app.

• Scan the QR code provided by PTT. Alternatively, you can simply paste the verification key to set it up, or use it only as a authenticator.

• Multiple accounts can be logged in simultaneously and switched at any time. Each account's favorites, following, and history are separate (VIP).

• You can tweet and post with another account without logging out and back in (VIP).

• Passwords and verification keys are encrypted and stored on your device; isPTT's servers do not accept passwords.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Easy-to-Read Articles】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Titles, authors, body text, and tweets are rearranged without scrolling left or right.

• Tables, ANSI colors, and layout are aligned as before; even the illustrations on the board won't be lost.

• Tweets are color-coded (push/hush/→), with comments; the title column instantly counts push/hush numbers.

• One-click to pin to the bottom to see the latest tweets; scrolling up automatically reads previous ones.

• Image and video links in the article are displayed directly; you can set it to only work on Wi-Fi. Automatic loading

• Image viewer can zoom in, swipe left and right to skip to the next image, save the entire article's images to the album at once, and specify the album.

• URL preview: Links display titles and thumbnails, read by the isPTT server; the other website cannot see your IP address (off by default, must be turned on manually).

• Articles read aloud, listen while doing other things.

• 11 Choose your own style and color scheme, and adjust the font size of the text.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Useful Lists】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

・Infinitely scrollable article list, categories, tweet count, read/unread status clearly displayed.

・You decide whether the latest articles are at the top or bottom.

・Search by title, author, tweet count, or article code.

・Title filtering: Articles containing certain words are not displayed (e.g., to avoid seeing political content).

・Blacklist: Articles and tweets from blocked users disappear immediately.

・Full backup: Settings, blacklist, title filtering, push notification subscriptions, browsing history, and followed articles can be imported and exported in one go, and transferred easily when switching phones.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Posting, Tweeting, and In-Site Functions】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

・Full-screen editor: Posting, replying, editing articles, and sending emails all use the same interface, with preview, undo/redo, and 78 characters per line. Tips

・Color codes can be used directly; preview will show colors.

・Long press on a tweet: search for the author, view their articles, view only their tweets, give P coins.

・Inbox, water balloon, friends, featured section, and board voting are all available.

・Automatically reconnects after disconnection and returns to the post you were originally viewing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【No ads, VIP sponsorship available】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

isPTT does not display ads. If you like, you can sponsor to purchase and unlock all VIP features in one go:

・Push Notifications: New posts, trending articles, title keywords, followed authors, and followed articles for your articles

・Popular Push List: Choose the boards where you want to push trending articles

・Fast Automatic Post Updates: Faster updates to keep up with the latest news

・Multiple Accounts Login Simultaneously: Each account's favorites, following, and history are separate

・VIP Style, VIP Stickers, VIP Profile (avatar, nickname, badge, visible to others)

・VIP Desktop Icon

・Longer Image Hosting (2 years), More Upload Quota

・No More Sponsorship Notifications

The three sponsorship levels (Gold, Platinum, Black Gold) have exactly the same features, the only difference being the badges.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Use with Confidence】

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

・Report or block inappropriate content; the content will immediately disappear from your device.

・Passwords are only stored on your device; isPTT's servers do not accept passwords.

・isPTT is a third-party developed PTT reader and is not affiliated with the official PTT platform.

・All content on the site is posted by PTT users themselves; this app neither creates nor edits this content.

Issue Reporting: support@isptt.app

description:
The "Guidance for the Lost" application is one of the official applications supervised by the General Secretariat of the Holy Shrine of Imam Hussein (peace be upon him) - Communications Department. It is considered a pioneering technical initiative aimed at serving honorable visitors during the Arbaeen pilgrimage to Imam Hussein (peace be upon him). This pilgrimage, one of the largest religious gatherings in the world, attracts millions of visitors from inside and outside Iraq. This makes organizing the crowds and providing humanitarian and service support major challenges that require innovative and rapid solutions.

With this in mind, the "Guidance for the Lost" application was launched as an effective and organized means of assisting in finding missing persons during the pilgrimage. The application is used within an integrated field system that includes dedicated centers known as "Guidance for the Lost" centers, which are spread throughout the pilgrimage areas to serve visitors and facilitate access to missing persons or reuniting them with their families.

The application records the data of those reported missing, including the following:

* Personal information such as full name, age, gender, and language.

* A recent photo of the missing person, taken directly from the center or sent via the application.

* The phone number of the person reporting the missing person or their relatives for easy communication when they are found.

The application is equipped with advanced technical features, most notably the "Smart Search" feature, based on artificial intelligence technologies. This feature accurately matches images and analyzes facial features, significantly helping to expedite the process of identifying and locating missing persons in record time, even when accurate information about them is not available.

The application's role is not limited to technical aspects alone; it is part of an integrated service and humanitarian system that contributes to reassuring families and providing the safest possible environment amidst the millions of people who visit. Visitors can also use the application to report any lost person or to report them in a specific location, expanding the search area and increasing the effectiveness of coordination between field teams and the digital application.

"Guiding the Lost" is one of the successful examples of the use of modern technology in the service of religious and humanitarian rituals, combining field efforts with technological advancements to achieve a noble humanitarian goal during one of the holiest occasions for Muslims.

This application, thanks to its continuous updates, embodies the Holy Shrine of Imam Hussein's commitment to providing the best services to visitors. It also expresses its vision of utilizing technology to serve the community, especially in sensitive circumstances that require a rapid and accurate response.

description:
Grindr helps gay, bi, trans, queer, and curious people find local connections for conversations, friendships, dates, meetups, and community advice. It is designed for people who want to see others in their area or connect with locals while visiting another city. The app lets each user decide how much to share on their profile, which can make early conversations feel more comfortable. You can download Grindr to explore its local LGBTQ social network on an Android phone.


Grindr features

Find people nearby

Grindr shows profiles in a grid based on location, so you can see people around you without searching for a specific name. This is useful when you want to start a conversation locally or check who is active in your area. The nearby view can also help when you are looking for friends, dates, or people who know the local LGBTQ scene.

Chat and share private photos

You can message another person directly after finding a profile that interests you. Grindr also lets you share private photos and create photo albums. Album access is under your control, so you can grant access to a person and remove it later if needed.

Use tags and profile filters

Grindr lets you add interest tags to your own profile and look for people with shared interests. Filters can narrow the profile list by details such as online status, photos, position, and relationship status. As a result, you can spend less time scrolling through profiles that do not match what you are looking for.

Connect while traveling

When you visit a new city, Grindr can help you meet local LGBTQ people and begin a conversation before or during your trip. You can ask locals about venues, restaurants, bars, and events in the area. This makes the app useful for community connections as well as dating and chatting.

Manage your interactions

You can favorite profiles that you may want to find again later. If a conversation or profile makes you uncomfortable, Grindr lets you block that person or report users and content in the app. These controls help you decide who can continue interacting with you.


Grindr free access and paid plans

The standard Grindr experience includes profile browsing, messaging, tags, filters, and account controls. Grindr XTRA and Grindr Unlimited are paid subscriptions for users who want additional browsing and messaging options. Before choosing a plan, consider whether the extra filters and profile visibility controls match how often you use the app.

Grindr XTRA includes ad free browsing, more profiles in the grid, and additional filters. Grindr Unlimited adds further options, including unlimited profile browsing, Viewed Me access, Incognito Mode, and tools to unsend messages or photos. Incognito Mode allows you to browse profiles without appearing in their Viewed Me list.


Grindr Web for subscribers

Grindr Web is available to eligible subscribers and allows chatting and profile browsing through a web browser. It is an option for users who want to continue conversations away from their Android phone. Access to Grindr Web depends on the subscription features available with your account.


How to use Grindr on Android

Start by setting up a profile and choosing the details you want other people to see. Then browse nearby profiles, use filters when needed, and begin conversations at your own pace. The Grindr latest version may include the current set of profile and subscription options offered by the service.

  1. Open Grindr and create your profile by adding the information, photos, and interest tags you choose to share.

  2. Allow location access if you want the nearby grid to show people around your current area.

  3. Browse profiles and use search filters to narrow the list by details that matter to you, such as online status or relationship status.

  4. Open a profile and send a direct message when you want to start a conversation. You can share private photos or an album only when you choose.

  5. Favorite people you want to revisit, and use block or report options if you do not want further contact from a profile.


Get started with Grindr

Grindr combines nearby LGBTQ profile discovery with direct chat, travel focused local connections, and controls for managing conversations. Download the Grindr APK if you want to use these tools on an Android device and review the available free and paid options first.

Make your own WhatsApp stickers. Sticko is a free sticker maker that turns any photo, GIF

or video into an animated WASticker pack, then adds it to WhatsApp with one tap.

No design skills needed. Start from a picture on your phone, cut out the subject, add text

and emoji, and export. Static or animated, both work.

Or skip the making entirely: browse over a million stickers already published by the Sticko

community and download the packs you like.

CREATE STICKERS

• Photo to sticker — cut out people, pets and objects

• GIF and video to animated sticker

• Save drafts and finish them later

• Export static or animated packs straight to WhatsApp

DOWNLOAD STICKER PACKS

• Over a million WASticker packs, free

• Love, birthday and anniversary wishes

IN YOUR LANGUAGE

Sticko speaks 13 languages — English, Hindi, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, Arabic, Urdu,

description:
Comehome is the app that connects people in real life, with more than 800 events per month and a community of over 300,000 constantly growing users.

By accessing the comehome app you will find events of all kinds: live unique experiences! Nurture your interests and make new friends in your city and in other parts of the world!

You choose the type of event you want to attend:

• LIVE Events: events at home and in the open air, which take place in the cities of Milan, Rome, Turin and Barcelona.

• ONLINE Events: interactive video call events that you can easily and quickly access from your smartphone, tablet or PC, wherever you are.

== Join the community now! Using comehome app is easy and fun! ==

• Download the free comehome app and register in a few simple steps

• Choose the type of event that's right for you, based on your interests and age range

• Get your pass in a few steps

• Participate and experience the comehome effect!

== HOW THE COMEHOME EXPERIENCE WORKS ==

1- Events: you decide how to participate, Online or Live, and choose the format that's right for you.

2- Filters: use them to immediately find the activities you like! Comehome events categories are: Party & Social, Sport & Wellness, Food, Art & Music, Games, Training, Talk and Special.

3- Hosts: They are the people who organize the events. You too, if you want, can propose your event and become a Host of our community.

4- Welcome: you will always feel at ease and meet people with interests similar to yours, sociable and open to making new acquaintances. In small events, it is easier to interact and make new friends!

5- Quality: the comehomers' reviews are fundamental to grant the high level of the comehome experience.

== Be part of it! -==

What are you doing tonight? Comehome events are many and for all tastes, there are no limits to our hosts’ imagination! Both Online and Live, you can find: cooking classes, live music, fitness, pilates, yoga, language lessons, board games, literary clubs, creativity, cinema, theatre, and much more.

== Reviews ==

To best choose the experience that's right for you, you can read the reviews that other comehomers have written about hosts and their past events.

== Follow the Host ==

The event you like is sold out? Do not worry! With the "Follow the Host" function, you can follow the people who organize your favourite formats. As soon as their new event is published, you will be notified by notification in the app and you will be able to get accredited before the seats are snapped up.

== Become a Host ==

Becoming a host is very easy! Create your own format, define a maximum number of participants and establish a contribution fee to access your event. If you can't wait to organize your first comehome, enter the app and access the reserved area!

== Invite friends ==

If you like comehome, also invite your friends to use the app! For each friend who participates in the first event, you will receive a 5 € credit to attend the events. Find all the info in the dedicated area.

== Comehome Values ==

In the era of social networks, our mission is to rediscover the pleasure of meeting people and sharing real life. Comehome was created to offer the opportunity to open the doors to something new, within a trust-based community, united by the values ​​of mutual respect, friendship and real sharing.

== Facebook groups ==

Join the community by subscribing to the Facebook Groups Comehome in the languages ​​you prefer and to the group of your city.

Join your first comehome event, we can't wait to meet you!

Who can use INFLUISH?

INFLUISH is for creators across niches, including fashion, beauty, fitness, food, travel, gaming, comedy, education and lifestyle.

Can I find paid brand collaborations?

Eligible creators can discover and apply to paid campaigns. Brands select creators based on campaign requirements.

Are barter collaborations available?

Yes. Explore product-based collaborations and check eligibility requirements before applying.

Do I need a large following?

You need at least 1,000 followers to apply for paid and barter collaborations. Individual campaign requirements may vary.

Can INFLUISH help me grow on Instagram?

Yes. Auto-DM and Instagram Insights help you manage audience interactions and understand content performance.

Do I need to share my Instagram password?

No. Connect securely through Meta's official authentication flow. INFLUISH never requires your Instagram password.
